description: Metadata for public Johns Hopkins Institute for Assured Autonomy pages. Hosts are iaa.jhu.edu and www.iaa.jhu.edu. Publisher is Johns Hopkins Institute for Assured Autonomy. www.iaa.jhu.edu does not resolve. robots.txt on iaa.jhu.edu was an HTML Cloudflare and cookie block, so no page was stored and this catalog is empty. Other Johns Hopkins hosts, person profiles, PDFs, and login walls are omitted. Rows store a title, publisher, canonical URL, publication date, and rights. Page text, abstracts, quotes, transcripts, and chart data are not stored. creative_commons_attribution means CC BY alone. creative_commons means CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix of those. A missing publication date is unknown. A year-only date stays unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. This catalog is not a belief collector and runner_wired is false.
